about: A fixed test vector for a Composio webhook delivery's signature, for any verifier of it to test against the same bytes. Not a real key.
scheme: Standard Webhooks headers and message, webhook-signature: v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}">, keyed by the UTF-8 bytes of the whole secret string, whsec_ prefix included and nothing decoded (as @composio/core 0.31.0 signs: utils/crypto.ts hmacSha256Base64 imports TextEncoder().encode(secret) as the raw key).
body_bytes: body is the request's raw body, its UTF-8 encoding exactly (356 bytes, non-ASCII included); body_sha256 is the SHA-256 of those bytes, so a reader can check it has them.
time: webhook_timestamp is fixed: a verifier with a timestamp window checks this vector with its clock set to that time.

decoded_key_negative.about: What a signer keyed by the base64-decoded part after whsec_ would send for the same message: a correct verifier refuses it.
